items.title: Royal Caribbean (RCL) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Back Sandals Deal
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises is back in focus as analysts lift price targets into the US$350 to nearly US$400 range, supported by fresh research and recent company updates. Many point to confidence in execution on demand, pricing, and the Sandals joint venture, while others flag consumer health and fuel costs as reasons to be more cautious.
